hypotheses.justification: An equivalence of abelian categories is automatically additive: it preserves limits (isEquivalencePreservesLimits), hence binary products and terminal objects, and therefore zero morphisms (preservesZeroMorphisms_of_preserves_terminal_object). Apply Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products to obtain a local Additive instance, then use the existing proof unchanged. Neither Functor.Linear nor the conclusion requires this binder to elaborate. This argument also applies to trivial abelian categories.
